sources.quote: Premium pricing applies for prompts exceeding 200k tokens ($10/$37.50 per million input/output tokens), available only on the Claude Platform.
sources.supports: Anthropic's launch announcement confirms the >200k input/output premium tier was official when Opus 4.6 launched.

sources.quote: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 now include the full 1M context window at standard pricing on the Claude Platform. Standard pricing applies across the full window — $5/$25 per million tokens for Opus 4.6 and $3/$15 for Sonnet 4.6.
sources.supports: Anthropic announced full-window standard pricing (no long-context surcharge) for Opus 4.6; the announcement was published March 13, 2026.

sources.quote: Claude 4.6 and later models and [Claude Mythos Preview](https://anthropic.com/glasswing) include the full [1M token context window](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows) at standard pricing.
sources.supports: Current provider pricing documentation confirms standard pricing across the full 1M context window.

notes: This was a real provider price change: Anthropic's February 5 launch post stated the premium above 200k tokens, and its March 13 announcement said standard pricing now applied across the full 1M window. Anthropic states the announcement's date as March 13, 2026; it gives no time or timezone.
